source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each Action states when it starts, which friendly units may perform it, its use limit, when it completes, its effect and any extra restrictions. A unit cannot **start an Action** if it:

- is off the battlefield
- is **AIRCRAFT** or **FORTIFICATION**
- is **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**
- has an [Objective Control](vsdata:core-rule/profiles) value of 0 or –
- is **[Engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**, other than a **TITANIC** unit
- [Advanced](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [Fell Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) this turn
- already started an Action this turn

Once it starts one, until the turn ends it cannot declare a charge, and it can shoot only if it is **TITANIC**.

It fails to complete the Action if it leaves the battlefield or makes any move other than a [Pile-in](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) or [Consolidation](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move); otherwise the Action's Effect applies when it completes.
